patches.name: keep-window-size
patches.description: After startup the PS5 build resizes its window to the saved ResolutionSizeX/Y through r.SetRes, which it rewrites to 3840x2160. The edit makes the r.SetRes sink skip that resize, so the window keeps the size of the output resolution below.

resolution.description: The window and back buffers are sized from PS5.DefaultBackBufferWidth/Height, registered read-only as 3840x2160. Each field is the 32-bit immediate a mov passes to the registration.
